def isPeakValley (lst : List Int) (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond (lst)) : Bool :=
  let len := lst.length
  if len < 3 then false
  else
    let incPart := List.drop 0 (List.take (len - 2) lst)
    let decPart := List.drop (List.length incPart - 2) lst
    if (List.zip incPart (List.drop 1 incPart)).all (fun (a, b) => a < b) ∧
       (List.zip decPart (List.drop 1 decPart)).all (fun (a, b) => a > b) then true
    else false
